instructions: SuperTracker is a tracker DAW running on the user's Mac. These tools read and edit the song that is open right now; every edit appears in the app immediately and is one ⌘Z undo step labelled "AI: …". Start with get_song (and read_pattern / screenshot to see the music). Tracks, instruments and rows are 0-based; notes use names like C-4 (= MIDI 60). Buses, the master channel, outputs and sends: get_mixer (address them with channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>"). Do not start playback unless the user asks.

tools.name: get_song
tools.description: Overview of the song open in SuperTracker: name, tempo, meter, rows per bar, tracks (instrument, mute/solo, volume, pan, sends, effects), instruments (type, sample, plug-in, NKS), patterns (id, name, length, note count), the song sequence as blocks, send effects, keyboard performance (scale/chords) and undo history. Call this first.

tools.name: get_ui_state
tools.description: What the user currently sees: view, open dialog, pattern, cursor track/row/column and the step under it, selection, current instrument, transport position.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the SuperTracker window as a PNG image to see exactly what the user sees.

width.description: Image width in pixels (320–2560). Default: the window width.

tools.name: read_pattern
tools.description: Read a pattern's steps: per track, each non-empty row with note name (C-4 = MIDI 60), instrument, velocity (1–127), gate (rows; only when the note has one), chord intervals and FX in readable form, plus automation lanes. format "grid" returns tracker-style text lines (compact for whole patterns).

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

tracks.description: Track or list of tracks (index or name). Default: all tracks.

tools.name: write_steps
tools.description: Write notes/steps into a pattern as ONE undo step. Each step: {track, row, note} with optional instrument, velocity, gate, chord, fx1, fx2; or notes:[...] for a chord; or clear:true. Existing steps are merged (only given fields change). Notes: "C-4"/"C4"/"C#4"/"Db3", MIDI numbers, "OFF" (note off: the track's notes release), "CUT" (they stop at once); note:null keeps only the FX. New steps use the track's instrument, velocity 100 and no gate: like a classic tracker a note plays until the next note on its track, an OFF or a CUT (one-shot samples end by themselves). Give gate only for a fixed length. column (0–7) picks a note column: a track plays up to 8 notes per row, each column its own voice (a new note, OFF or CUT ends only its own column); columns 1–7 hold note, instrument, velocity and gate, and the row's fx1/fx2 (column 0) apply to them.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

column.description: Note column, 0-based (default 0). Writing a column adds it to the track.

note.description: Note name, MIDI number, OFF, CUT, or null for an FX-only step.

notes.description: Chord notes; the first is the root (sets note and chord).

gate.description: Optional note length in rows (0.01–256; 0.8 ≈ most of a row). Omit for none (plays until the next note, OFF or CUT); 0 or null removes a gate.

chord.description: Chord as semitone intervals [0,4,7] or a chord name (major, minor, sus2, sus4, ...). null removes it.

fx1.description: Step effect, e.g. "probability 50%", "ratchet 3", "pitch -12", "cutoff 800Hz", "pan -30%", "reverse", "arpeggio 37" (+3 +7), "microtiming 25%", "volume 80%", "slice 4", "glide -12", "delay 40%", "reverb 30%", "offset 25%", "resonance 50%". null removes it.

fx2.description: Step effect, e.g. "probability 50%", "ratchet 3", "pitch -12", "cutoff 800Hz", "pan -30%", "reverse", "arpeggio 37" (+3 +7), "microtiming 25%", "volume 80%", "slice 4", "glide -12", "delay 40%", "reverb 30%", "offset 25%", "resonance 50%". null removes it.

clear.description: true clears the step (with column: that note column; column 0 keeps the other columns).

tools.name: clear_steps
tools.description: Clear a range of rows on some or all tracks, every note column included (one undo step).

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

tracks.description: Track or list of tracks (index or name). Default: all tracks.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: insert_rows
tools.description: Insert empty rows at a row; content below moves down and rows past the pattern end drop off.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

tracks.description: Track or list of tracks (index or name). Default: all tracks.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: delete_rows
tools.description: Delete rows at a row; content below moves up and empty rows fill the end.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

tracks.description: Track or list of tracks (index or name). Default: all tracks.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: transform_steps
tools.description: Transform notes in a range as one undo step. operation: transpose (amount semitones), humanize (amount = max velocity change, default 12), velocity (scale e.g. 1.2, or set 1–127), quantize (removes microtiming FX), snapToScale (scale + root), reverse, rotate (amount rows), gate (set rows; 0 removes gates so notes play until the next note), instrument (set), removeFX.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

tracks.description: Track or list of tracks (index or name). Default: all tracks.

scale.description: velocity: factor; snapToScale: scale name (major, minor, dorian, pentatonic, blues, ...).

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: create_pattern
tools.description: Create an empty pattern (selected in the editor unless select:false).

length.description: Rows (1–256). Default: the current pattern's length.

appendToSong.description: Also append it to the song sequence.

select.description: Show it in the editor (default true).

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: duplicate_pattern
tools.description: Copy a pattern (steps and automation) to a new pattern.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

appendToSong.description: Append the copy to the song.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: rename_pattern
tools.description: Rename a pattern.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

tools.name: delete_pattern
tools.description: Delete a pattern and remove it from the song sequence.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: set_pattern_length
tools.description: Set a pattern's length in rows (1–256). Shortening drops steps and automation past the end.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: edit_song_sequence
tools.description: Edit the song arrangement. The song is a list of blocks (one pattern repeated N times). Actions: set {sequence:[pattern | {pattern, repeats}]}, insert {pattern, block?, before?, repeats?} (no block = append), remove {block, toBlock?}, repeats {block, repeats}, replace {block, pattern}, move {block, toBlock?, delta -1|1}, duplicate {block, toBlock?}, loop {block, toBlock?} (loop that section), clearLoop.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

before.description: Insert before the block instead of after.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: add_track
tools.description: Add a track (no fixed limit; 1024 is a sanity bound).

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: edit_track
tools.description: Change a track: name, mute, solo, volume ("-6 dB" or 0–1.5 gain), pan ("30% L", "center", or -1…1), delaySend/reverbSend ("40%" or 0–1), instrument.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: set_song_settings
tools.description: Song settings: name, bpm (20–400), swing ("10%" or 0–0.75), timeSignature ("3/4"), linesPerBeat (rows per beat: 1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16), masterVolume ("-3 dB"), loopSong, metronome, metronomeVolume.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: get_instrument
tools.description: Read an instrument with every parameter in readable units, its range and options.

tools.name: create_instrument
tools.description: Create a sampler or external MIDI instrument, optionally setting parameters and assigning it to a track (one undo step). For a plain tone use the sampler's Wavetable mode with a built-in table (load_sample with a builtin:wavetables/... path). For plug-ins use load_plugin / load_nks.

params.description: Parameters by name with units, e.g. {"mode":"wavetable","wavetablePosition":"25%","cutoff":"800 Hz","attack":"5 ms","volume":"-6 dB"}.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: edit_instrument
tools.description: Rename an instrument or set parameters by name with units. Parameters: volume, pan, tune (semitones), tuneSemi, tuneFine (cents), attack, decay, sustain, release, cutoff, resonance, filterType, drive, bitDepth, filter envelope (filterAttack…filterEnvAmount), LFOs (lfoRate, lfoDepth, lfoTarget, lfoShape, lfoSync, lfoBeats, lfo2…), sampler (rootNote, start, end, loopStart, loopEnd, mode, sliceCount, grainSize, grainPosition, wavetablePosition, wavetableFrameSize).

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search the user's sample library (and NKS presets with kind "nks"/"all"). Returns paths usable with load_sample.

tools.name: load_sample
tools.description: Load an audio file (path) or the best library match (query) into an instrument, making it a sampler, and assign it to a track. Default instrument: the track's.

path.description: Absolute path to an audio file.

query.description: Library search words instead of a path.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.description: List installed plug-ins (AU, VST3, CLAP). One entry per plug-in (AU preferred) unless allFormats.

refresh.description: Re-read the plug-in list from the host.

tools.name: load_plugin
tools.description: Load a plug-in on a track: kind "instrument" (plays the track's notes) or "effect" (insert slot 0–15). channel instead of track loads an insert effect on a bus or the master channel ("master", bus name or "bus:<id>"; standard routing). Plug-in names (built-in effects such as "Reverb" or "Peak Limiter" too) are matched like list_plugins; use the id when ambiguous.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

channel.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

instrument.description: For instruments: instrument index to replace, or "new". Default: the track's own instrument if no other track uses it.

tools.name: get_plugin_parameters
tools.description: List a plug-in's parameters (name, address, current value and display, range) for a track's instrument or an effect slot of a track, bus or master (channel).

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

channel.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

tools.name: set_plugin_parameters
tools.description: Set plug-in parameters by name or address as one undo step, on a track's instrument or an effect slot of a track, bus or master (channel). Values: "50%" or {"normalized":0.5} = knob position; a plain number = the parameter's own value within min…max.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

channel.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: search_nks
tools.description: Search the NKS preset catalogue (Komplete/Kontakt/Massive and other NKS presets).

product.description: Limit to a product, e.g. "Massive X".

tools.name: load_nks
tools.description: Load an NKS preset (path from search_nks, or the best match for query) on a track as its instrument, or as an effect in a slot.

query.description: Search words instead of a path.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

slot.description: Effect slot 0–15; defaults to the first free slot (a full rack needs an explicit slot to replace).

instrument.description: "new" to add a new instrument instead of replacing the track's.

tools.name: list_automation_targets
tools.description: List parameters that can be automated on a track, bus or master (channel): mixer, instrument, sends, plug-in parameters, with ranges and current values.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

channel.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

tools.name: set_automation
tools.description: Create or replace an automation lane for a track, bus or master (channel) parameter in a pattern. points [{row, value}] use the parameter's units ("800 Hz", "-6 dB", or numbers in its range; plug-in targets 0–1 or "50%"). Buses: volume, pan, send:<id>, plug-in effects; master: volume and plug-in effects (standard routing). merge:true keeps existing points at other rows.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

channel.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: delete_automation
tools.description: Delete a track's, bus's or master's (channel) automation lane for a target in a pattern.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

channel.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: get_mixer
tools.description: The mixer: mix model (legacy/standard), master (volume, inserts), group/return buses (id, level, pan, mute/solo, output, inputs, sends, inserts with slot/format/bypass), every track's level, output, sends and inserts, sidechains, and the built-in delay/reverb send effects. Use it to find bus ids and insert slots. channel limits it to one channel.

channel.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

tools.name: edit_channel
tools.description: Change mixer channels as one undo step: name, volume ("-6 dB"; tracks and master up to 1.5 gain, buses up to 2), pan ("30% L"), mute, solo, output (a group/return bus, "master" or "none"; standard routing). channel may list several channels (not for name). Master takes volume only.

channel.description: Mixer channel or list of channels: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name.

output.description: Output destination: a bus name or "bus:<id>", "master", or "none"/null to disconnect.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: create_bus
tools.description: Create a group or return bus (standard routing) as one undo step. inputs: tracks/buses whose output moves to the new bus (group buses); return buses are fed with set_send. The bus outputs to Master unless output says otherwise.

inputs.description: Mixer channel or list of channels: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name.

output.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: remove_bus
tools.description: Remove a group or return bus with its inserts, sends and automation (one undo step). Channels that output to it move to the bus's own output. A track group's (kit's) bus is removed by dissolving the group instead.

channel.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: set_send
tools.description: Add, change or remove a custom send (standard routing) from a track or bus to a group/return bus or Master, as one undo step. A send from→to that exists is edited; otherwise it is created (gain 0 dB, post-fader). The built-in delay/reverb sends are edit_track delaySend/reverbSend.

from.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

to.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

id.description: Send id (see get_mixer), instead of from/to.

remove.description: true removes the send and its automation.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: set_send_effects
tools.description: Settings of the built-in delay and reverb send effects (one undo step). delay: time ("375 ms" or a tempo division like "1/8.", "1/16", "1/4T"), feedback (0–95%), tone (100% = open), mix (return level). reverb: size, damping, predelay (0–250 ms), mix.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: edit_insert
tools.description: Bypass, remove or reorder an insert effect of a track, bus or master (channel) by slot, as one undo step: exactly one of bypass (true/false), remove (true; its automation goes too) or moveTo (another insert's slot, "first" or "last"; the others shift). Add inserts with load_plugin.

channel.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

moveTo.description: Slot of the insert whose position it takes, "first" or "last".

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: enable_standard_routing
tools.description: Switch a legacy-mix song to standard routing so it can have buses, track outputs, custom sends and master inserts (one undo step). It changes the gain order (track faders after inserts, master gain after the routing graph): ask the user first.

label.description: Optional undo label (shown as "AI: <label>" in Edit › Undo).

tools.name: set_performance
tools.description: Keyboard performance settings used when the user plays the computer keyboard / MIDI: scale, root, chord, chordSet ("" = off), scaleMode (snap/degrees), octave. Call with no arguments to list the options.

chordSet.description: Chord set id, or "" to turn off.

tools.name: transport
tools.description: Play/stop. action: play (current mode), playPattern, playSong, stop, status. Options: pattern, row (start row), block (song block to start from), loop {from, to} rows for pattern playback (null clears). Mind the user's ears: ask before playing.

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last edit(s) — yours (labelled "AI: …") or the user's — exactly like ⌘Z.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo, like ⌘⇧Z.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Recent undo and redo labels.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Save the project to its file, or to path (absolute, .supertracker). Unsaved sessions need a path.

tools.name: export_audio
tools.description: Render the song or one pattern to a WAV file (offline, silent).

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: List command-palette (⌘K) commands with ids.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a command-palette command by id; it acts on the current view/selection (use show_in_app first). Commands that open dialogs wait for the user.

tools.name: show_in_app
tools.description: Point the user's view at something (no undo step): view (pattern, instrument, browser, mixer, automation, song), pattern, track, row, column (note/instrument/velocity/fx1/fx2), instrument, select {fromTrack,toTrack,fromRow,toRow} or null, channel (selects a mixer channel; shows the mixer unless view is given).

pattern.description: Pattern id (see get_song) or name. Default: the pattern shown in the editor.

track.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

fromTrack.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

toTrack.description: Track: 0-based index (the UI shows 01 for track 0) or track name.

channel.description: Mixer channel: "master", a bus name or "bus:<id>", or a track index/name (see get_mixer).

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Call any STAgent API method directly (advanced). Use method "help" to list every method and its parameters.
